deployments_detail.use: Machine-learning system to decode traditional Moutai brewing/fermentation into scientific parameters

Machine-learning brewing system that decodes traditional distilling ('experience black box'): using CatBoost and LightGBM decision-tree algorithms it built five process-evaluation models (grain soaking, steaming, spreading/cooling, stacking, in-pit fermentation) predicting 9 key indicators such as grain expansion rate and average steaming output. Deployed in Brewing Workshop 15 with 124 cameras and 186 wireless sensors collecting 15M+ data points/year. [In-house (CatBoost, LightGBM)]
deployments_detail.value: Overall prediction accuracy 83.2%; grain expansion rate accuracy up to 97.6%; ~15M data points/year at 0.39% error rate

deployments_detail.use: 'DeepSeek + production management' mode: uses DeepSeek large model to perform real-time monitoring and analysis of brewing-workshop temperature, humidity and microbial data to assist and optimize production decisions. [DeepSeek]

AI machine-vision defect inspection of Moutai glass liquor bottles on the production line: deep-learning visual inspection machines detecting bottle appearance/printing/label defects to replace manual quality inspection. [Keye Technology (科亿科技)]
deployments_detail.value: Described as a 'super-million-yuan-level' benchmark project (10 glass-bottle inspection machines supplied)

deployments_detail.use: AI for brand marketing: launched a 'using DeepSeek and other AI large models to enhance brand influence' program; 'DeepSeek + new media' mode generates creative scripts for short-video content promoting Moutai culture. [DeepSeek]

i-Moutai app customer service: launched an 'AI intelligent assistance system' alongside expanded human agents to improve after-sales/customer-service response efficiency, addressing congested service channels amid 10M+ customer inquiries. [none]
DeepSeek and SenseTime large-model training program for dealers and regional staff

Enterprise-wide DeepSeek adoption for smart office / back-office productivity, with hands-on employee training programs ('DeepSeek Empowering Efficient Smart Office') simulating real Moutai office scenarios, plus a 'DeepSeek + customer management' mode analyzing client needs for personalized service strategies. [DeepSeek]

'Smart Moutai' liquor-warehouse security & safety AI (with Huawei): integrated security/fire-protection system in the core storage/blending-and-storage workshop using AI-based intelligent recognition and localization of anomalous events, turning passive alerting into proactive early warning. [Huawei (IoT, 5G, cloud, AI)]
deployments_detail.value: 5-second event identification, 10-second alert delivery; 23 storage buildings + 1 office building, 10,000+ integrated devices, 20+ business roles served

deployments_detail.use: i-Moutai digital marketing platform risk-control system combining big data, AI, and business-strategy rules with the Moutai 'Tiangong' blockchain to build a multi-dimensional anti-scalping/fair-purchase risk framework for its ~100M-user flash-sale channel. [In-house (Tiangong blockchain, big data, AI)]
deployments_detail.value: Tiangong chain single-day on-chain processing >1 billion records; concurrency >300,000/second

deployments_detail.use: Alibaba Cloud won the i-Moutai public-cloud project, supplying computing, database/middleware, big data, network and large-model (大模型) resources to power the i-Moutai digital marketing platform (~96M registered users). [Alibaba Cloud (incl. large model / Tongyi resources)]
